item.title: Nebraska Medicine to toss lawsuit against NU Board of Regents, Clarkson Health
item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — Nebraska Medicine is tossing the lawsuit filed last month involving the University of Nebraska Board of Regents and Clarkson Regional Health Services.
